title: Guide: Chat implementer's guide to VTC integration
description: Write jmap-chat-vtc-integration-guide.md for Chat implementers adding call support. Covers: advertising urn:ietf:params:jmap:vtc alongside chat, creating VTCCalls from chat UI (start call button, /call slash command), binding calls to Chats/Spaces/channels, rendering activeCallId banner, start_call permission gating, Space-bound call access control inheritance, call history in chat context, MessageAction type urn:jmap:chat:cap:vtc for call invitations in message flow.
